identify: Small round to irregular spots with a grey center and a dark edge appear on the leaves.
The spots start on the lower leaves and move upwards.
damage: The spots join and the leaves dry up and fall. Fruits are rarely attacked.

cultural: Remove and destroy the affected plant parts.

safety: Spray only when the disease is seen on the crop. Wear gloves and a mask when you spray.
